title: CR4T：面向青少年LLM安全的基于重写的护栏框架
summary: CR4T是一个模型无关的安全框架，通过选择性重写不安全或拒绝式输出，将其转化为适合年龄的指导性回应，同时保留良性意图。实验表明，该方法能有效减少不安全内容和对话中断，为青少年AI交互提供更人性化的替代方案。
summary_en: CR4T is a model-agnostic safeguarding framework that selectively rewrites unsafe or refusal-style outputs into age-appropriate, guidance-oriented responses while preserving benign intent. Experiments show it reduces unsafe content and conversational dead-ends, offering a human-centered alternative for adolescent LLM safety.
